runtime_consumption: build-time source ownership only; never current runtime map

map_rules.authority: pinned map.json region field and existing map-group registration

operand_rules.polymorphic_object_field: Pushable boulder trainer_type is the documented reveal flag; ordinary trainer_type values remain unchanged

consumer_reconciliation.scope: all pinned tracked source paths, including inactive, shared, macro, testing, and indirect references
consumer_reconciliation.pointer_uses: trace aliases, dereferences, casts, contiguous spans, and callee use
consumer_reconciliation.dynamic_reads: validate before Boolean interpretation, indexing, progression checks, or side effects
consumer_reconciliation.dynamic_writes: validate all identifiers before any dependent side effect or partial output write
consumer_reconciliation.qualification: inventory alone is not safety verification

mod_persistence: separate native platform requirement; no GBA save-sector allocation
